title: Use ARIA to supplement, not replace, semantics
guideline: Prefer native semantic elements first; use ARIA roles only when no native element fits

title: Trap and restore focus for modals
guideline: Trap focus within an open modal and return it to the trigger element on close

title: Avoid clobbering browser/OS shortcuts
guideline: Don't override common shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl+F, Tab, Esc) without a clear, documented reason

title: Use landmark regions for page structure
guideline: Wrap the page in header/nav/main/footer so assistive tech can jump between regions

title: Virtualize offscreen content on long pages
guideline: Use content-visibility: auto or windowing for very long scrollable pages

title: Every page needs a unique title and description
guideline: Set a descriptive <title> and meta description per route for SEO/sharing

title: Serve appropriately sized images per device
guideline: Use srcset/sizes or <picture> so mobile doesn't download desktop-resolution images

title: Use correct input types and autocomplete
guideline: Use type='email'/'tel' and autocomplete attributes to speed up form filling

title: Use links for navigation, buttons for actions
guideline: <a> changes the URL/navigates; <button> triggers an action — don't mix them up

title: Respect the OS color scheme preference
guideline: Use prefers-color-scheme as the default theme unless the user overrides it

title: Handle offline/network-failure states gracefully
guideline: Detect and communicate offline/failed-request states instead of a silent hang

title: Provide sensible print styles where relevant
guideline: Hide nav/chrome and ensure readable print layout for content-heavy pages (invoices, articles)

title: Ship basic PWA/browser metadata
guideline: Include a favicon, apple-touch-icon, and web manifest for a polished browser presence

title: Declare the page's language
guideline: Set <html lang='en'> (or the correct locale) so assistive tech and translators work correctly

title: Indicate links that open in a new tab
guideline: Add a visual cue and rel='noopener noreferrer' for target='_blank' links
